## 3. Existing security controls

- Mandatory API security rules: `AGENTS.md` (Zod body validation, rate limits on public routes, HMAC-verified webhooks, no mass assignment, secret stripping, CSPRNG only, address validation, oracle sanity bounds).
- Route manifest: 373 API handlers, each classified by auth model and enforced in CI (`apps/web/security/route-manifest.json`):
  - ADMIN_ONLY: 30
  - API_KEY_AUTHENTICATED: 10
  - AUTHENTICATED_USER: 159
  - DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: 2
  - INTERNAL_ONLY: 9
  - PUBLIC_INTENTIONAL: 150
  - WEBHOOK_VERIFIED: 13
- CI workflows (14): `ci.yml`, `container-scan.yml`, `contract-security.yml`, `deep-security-scan.yml`, `dependabot-automerge.yml`, `infra-validate.yml`, `ios-guardian.yml`, `mobile-release.yml`, `native-pr.yml`, `release-changesets.yml`, `release.yml`, `scorecard.yml`, `security-audit.yml`, `security-autofix.yml`.
